title: The finally audit log
prompt: Write `tryResource(boolean fail)` that appends to a `StringBuilder` exactly: `"open;"` always; then, if `fail` is true, throw `IllegalStateException`; otherwise append `"work;"` then `"close;"`. Add `"catch;"` in a catch block and `"finally;"` in a finally block. Return the log **once, at the very end** - after the finally block (a `return` inside try/catch escapes before `finally` can append).

tests.name: success path order
tests.hint: Return once, after the finally block - not inside try or catch.

tests.name: failure path order
tests.hint: On failure the try block stops at the throw - work/close never append.
